name: react-vite

exampleDomain.note: Every pack and seam uses the same example domain. The L0 contract passes this value to the seam and the gate's --pair checks it — this repairs the measured defect where the frontend called /tasks while the backend served /notes

fixesVariantsNote: The SPA axis picks the router·global state·server cache all by itself — all three are premises of the pack body. Do not assemble it for a project that chose TanStack Router·Redux·SWR
